title: Bulls return as Fed rate pause, dip in US yields lift sentiment
summary: Indian equities experienced a broad recovery as Sensex rose significantly and Nifty surpassed 22,900. This increase followed the US Federal Reserve's decision to keep interest rates unchanged, encouraging investor buying across sectors. While many indices gained, oil prices remained a concern for India's economy due to their elevated levels. Foreign portfolio investors continued to net sell shares, contrasting with the strong buying from domestic institutions.

Several companies reported varied profit results for the September quarter, impacting market sentiment. Regulatory developments and credit rating updates are also being closely monitored by investors. The upcoming earnings announcements from notable companies will further influence market activity.

title: D-St set for a cautious opening as GIFT Nifty signals muted start
summary: In a significant trading session, benchmark indices registered solid gains, reflecting renewed market confidence following the Fed's interest rate announcement. The second half saw a notable uptick in buying, enhancing broader market performance. Analysts are hopeful for a continuation towards the 23,100 mark if support levels are sustained. Interestingly, foreign portfolio investors were net sellers while domestic institutional players showed bullish tendencies.

title: Kotak Bank shares gain 30% since April as earnings outlook brightens
summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank shares experienced a significant rise, reaching a record high as growth prospects improved. The stock has shown a substantial increase of nearly 30% since April. Analysts anticipate stronger earnings attributed to various financial factors such as credit growth and higher lending rates. Improved asset quality and lower credit costs are expected to enhance profitability. This positive trajectory follows a period of stagnant performance between 2021 and 2024.

title: Advance-decline ratio hits 7-month low as market breadth weakens
summary: The advance-to-decline ratio in the stock market indicates underlying weakness, despite some index gains. The BSE MidCap 150 and BSE SmallCap 250 have both seen declines this month. Various factors such as profit-booking and high valuations contribute to this market trend. Institutional money is increasingly favoring larger companies with stable earnings. Overall market conditions remain uncertain due to external economic pressures and geopolitical risks.

title: Stock Radar: Balkrishna Industries stock breaks out from falling parallel channel; time to buy the stock which is in bear grip?
summary: Balkrishna Industries Ltd has recently broken out from a falling parallel channel, indicating potential recovery. The stock has found support in the Rs 1,900 to 2,000 range three times since June. Analysts suggest buying the stock with a target above Rs 2,400 within the next few months. A successful retest of the breakout line as support would confirm a change of trend.

title: Health insurers seek expense cap tweaks
summary: Standalone health insurers have requested that mandatory insurance products be excluded from expense-of-management calculations. They argue that including these products creates an imbalance for their business model. The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India is considering changes to EoM regulations and limits. Insurers believe that the exclusion would help provide a more equitable competitive landscape. The proposed changes aim to revise expense calculation methods and set product-wise commission caps.

title: West Asia conflict drives 15-20% rise in corporate working-capital demand at banks
summary: Working-capital demand from banks has increased significantly due to the ongoing conflict in West Asia. Higher raw-material costs and elongated shipping timelines have led to greater funding needs for corporates. Mid- and large-sized companies reported a 12-20% increase in working-capital requirements. Several private sector banks have recorded strong growth in corporate lending during the recent quarter. This momentum was driven primarily by working capital needs and refinancing efforts.

title: Fintechs to lay out a code for technology vendors amid rising cyberthreats and security risks
summary: Unified Fintech Forum is developing a framework to encourage best practices among technology service providers. This initiative aims to improve cybersecurity preparedness and operational resilience in the fintech sector. Banks and fintech companies increasingly rely on third-party vendors for various services and their failures can impact regulated entities. Registration with the Forum may provide these vendors with preference during selection by financial institutions.

title: ET EXPLAINER: What do the new REIT regulation amendments mean for investors?
summary: SEBI amended REIT regulations to revise unitholder voting thresholds, introduce exit options for dissenting investors during specified sponsor exits, permit depository receipts against REIT units and modify common infrastructure definitions, with implications for governance, investor protection and market access.

title: Equitas Small Finance Bank chief PN Vasudevan plans exit over perceived conflict involving daughter's NBFC
summary: PN Vasudevan's recent announcement of his resignation as managing director of Equitas Small Finance Bank highlights pressing concerns over a conflict of interest involving his daughter's NBFC. Following the news, the bank's shares experienced a drastic dip yet managed a partial recovery before settling lower. This comes on the heels of the bank's impressive Q2 net profit growth, showcasing its strong operational health.

title: PNB suspends 12 employees, files CBI case over alleged bank fraud involving ₹10 crore
summary: Punjab National Bank has taken action by suspending twelve staff members linked to unauthorized fund transfers utilizing the branch manager's password. Evidence points to a female employee collaborating with external parties in these transactions. Current estimates of the losses indicate they are below Rs 10 crore, contradicting widespread claims online.
